integrity: The sign isomorphism is an explicit basis change. Exactness of the equivalence relation follows from projective congruence of the nondegenerate bilinear form and the trace of its asymmetry. A symbolic checker independently verifies all matrix identities used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns only the parameter equivalence inside the AD7 family.
